mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.title, p.view_count, p.status, p.created_at, u.name AS author_name, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS author_thumbnail_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, (p.user_id = #{userId}) AS mine FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = u.user_id AND t.target_type = 'USER' AND t.target_id = u.user_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.post_id, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.name AS author_name, CONCAT('/uploads/', t.file_path) AS author_thumbnail_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id) AS comment_count, (p.user_id = #{userId}) AS mine FROM post p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN thumbnail_image t ON t.user_id = u.user_id AND t.target_type = 'USER' AND t.target_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
UPDATE post SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
UPDATE post SET status = 'WITHDRAWN' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'NORMAL'
